summary: Iteration 23 — verified the Paxity payment-return redirect fix (PaymentReturnRedirect in App.js). Ran all 6 scenarios from the review request against the live preview URL (site unlocked with alarba2026). SCENARIO 1: from home '/', with pending tx in localStorage, page auto-redirects to /commande and shows the 'Paiement en cours' screen with data-testid=paxity-manual-check-btn. SCENARIO 2: with DB flipped to success (tx_return_test + order 1000), the /commande page polls, transitions to the confirmation screen (data-testid=order-confirmed-title 'Votre commande est confirmée'), shows OrderSummary with 'Article retour — Taille M × 1', +221 771234567, Point E Dakar, retour@test.local, Commande #1000, toast 'Paiement confirmé', and localStorage sec_pending_paxity_tx_v1 is cleared. SCENARIO 3: /boutique with pending tx also redirects to /commande. SCENARIO 4: no pending tx → free navigation home→boutique→panier, zero redirect to /commande. SCENARIO 5: paxity-cancel-pending-btn removes localStorage key; subsequent reload of home does not redirect. SCENARIO 6: with pending tx in localStorage, /vendeur/login is NOT redirected (seller area properly excluded by PaymentReturnRedirect). Mandatory DB cleanup performed: orders id '1000' and paxity_transactions id 'tx_return_test' deleted, counters._id='order_number' seq reset to 0, products remains empty.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js PaymentReturnRedirect (L42-57): correctly checks path exclusions (/commande, /vendeur, /admin, /paiement) and only fires once at mount (empty deps). Note: uses window.location.pathname at effect run — inside a BrowserRouter subtree useLocation would be more idiomatic but functionally equivalent on first mount.

Checkout.jsx L56-66 restore effect + L69-76 persist effect are well-paired; polling loop L94-132 uses focus/visibilitychange listeners as documented — resilient to Paxity return via tab focus even without the App.js redirect.
OrderSummary.jsx L15 swallows fetch errors silently (`.catch(() => {})`). Consider surfacing a 'Chargement du récapitulatif indisponible' state for observability, but not a blocker.
test_credentials: Site unlock: alarba2026 (localStorage.sec_site_unlocked_v1). Seller creds not needed for this test (only /vendeur/login route load was verified).
seed_data_creation: Used the pre-seeded db.orders id='1000' + db.paxity_transactions id='tx_return_test' provided by the main agent. Flipped both to 'success' via /app/backend python+motor script for Scenario 2. Mandatory cleanup executed: both docs deleted, counters.order_number seq reset to 0, products collection left empty (0 docs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Paxity return-redirect flow fully validated. The PENDING_TX_KEY is 'sec_pending_paxity_tx_v1' (Checkout.jsx). PaymentReturnRedirect is a mount-once effect — it will NOT re-fire on client-side navigation, so once the user is on /commande they can freely leave via internal navigation. The redirect only occurs on hard page loads (goto/reload) which is exactly the Paxity-return scenario. Site gate password is 'alarba2026' stored under sec_site_unlocked_v1 (the value must equal the password string, not just any truthy value).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — the fix is working as intended. Original bug (client stranded on Paxity after payment) is now resolved by (a) Paxity configuring shoppingenchine.com as the return URL, and (b) PaymentReturnRedirect in App.js that intercepts any hard page load with a pending tx in localStorage and sends the user to /commande where Checkout.jsx restores state, polls, and switches to the confirmation OrderSummary as soon as backend reports success.
